Alternative.description: One alternative: a full route, and how it relates to the others.

chokepoints.description: Edges of this route in the top decile of betweenness.

length.description: Planar length of the road geometry.

overlap_with.description: Shared length fraction against each other returned route, in order.

shared_edges_with_all.description: Edges every alternative uses: the pair's true chokepoints.

straight_line.description:
The distance between the endpoints, so `length / straight_line` is the
detour factor.

waypoints.description: At most one point per 500 m, and every graph node kept.

radius.description: The engagement or search radius each radial is marched in from.

sector.description: Summaries are also returned restricted to this sector.

bands.description: One per requested band, in order.

Box.description: An axis-aligned box in DCS metres, the canonical region.

asset_covered_fraction.description: Present when the request named an `asset`.

blind_approach_exists.description:
Some radial stays masked from the envelope's radius to inside
`min_masked_range`.

asset.description: An area whose coverage is reported on its own.

bands.description: One per requested band, in order.

Criterion.description:
One criterion, written `{"name": "slope_max", "params": {"deg": 8}}`.
`valid` takes no params and is applied whether asked for or not.

oneOf.description: Steepest slope over the footprint, at most `deg`.

Highest minus lowest height over the footprint's corners and centre,
at most `m`.
Every footprint cell's water class is one of `classes`.
Every footprint cell's `surface` code is one of `values`.
Distance to the nearest airdrome, or to `airdrome_id` when given.
Scenery objects of `class` within `radius`, at most `max`.
Scenery objects overlapping the footprint, at most `max`.

Objects of any class within `radius`: what a heliport static would
remove at spawn.

A ridge that way: every horizon bin in the sector rises at least
`min_elev_deg`.

The fraction of `observers` that can see the site at `own_alt_agl`,
at most `max_fraction`.

The fraction of `targets` the site sees from `own_alt_agl`, at least
`min_fraction`.

The site's landform class is one of `classes`, judged at
`threshold_m` of local and regional relief.

DescribeResponse.description: Everything the packed file says about itself.

meta.description: Every `meta` key and its stored text.

row_counts.description: Rows in each vector table, by table name.

validation.description: The `validation_*` keys, when the file has been stamped.

spacing.description: No two candidates returned are closer than this.

step.description: Candidate lattice spacing; twice the cell size when omitted.

weights.description: Weight per criterion name in the ranking sum; 1 for any not named.

Footprint.description: A rectangle to be placed, tried at each of its orientations.

GeoResponse.description: Each list in the order of the request's.

GridInfo.description: One row of the packed file's `grid` table.

params.description: The parameters that produced the grid, as the JSON text stored.

Issue.description:
One thing wrong with a request or with the file it was asked of. An
operation returns a full result or a list of these, never a partial.

code.description: Stable, machine-readable: `snake_case`, never reworded once shipped.

path.description:
Where in the request, dotted: `criteria.2.params.deg`. Empty when the
issue is not about one field.

exposure.description: The fraction of the leg the exposure observers see.

Nearby.description:
For road and rail, the closest point on the nearest edge, and `id` is the
edge's.

NearestKind.description: `node` matches both sides' nodes; each result's `kind` says which.

Network.description: A road network an operation runs over.

Observer.description: Someone looking: a position and an eye height above the ground.

Point3.description:
A point with a height, given either absolute or above the ground.

Exactly one of `alt` and `alt_agl` is set; `Point3::check` reports both or
neither as an issue. The pair is two fields rather than an enum so the JSON
reads `{"x": .., "z": .., "alt_agl": 2}`, the way a caller writes it.

Polygon.description: A simple polygon as `[x, z]` vertices, closed by its first point.

blind.description: Masked from the radius in to `min_masked_range`.

unmask_dist.description:
The range of the first step the site sees; null when the whole radial
is masked.

Region.description:
A region a request is bounded by. Each form is converted to its bounding
box plus a membership test before any grid is read.

oneOf.description: The ring between two distances from an airdrome's reference point.

avoid.description: No edge crossing any of these is used.

exposure_observers.description: Edges these observers see cost more, by `exposure_weight`.

max_overlap.description: No two alternatives share more than this fraction of their length.

max_stretch.description: No alternative longer than this times the shortest.

penalty.description: The weight multiplier on edges already used.

avoid.description: No edge crossing any of these is used.

exposure_observers.description: Edges these observers see cost more, by `exposure_weight`.

RouteResponse.description: The route found, with the file that answered.

length.description: Planar length of the road geometry.

straight_line.description:
The distance between the endpoints, so `length / straight_line` is the
detour factor.

waypoints.description: At most one point per 500 m, and every graph node kept.

RouteSpan.description: A stretch of a route, as distances along it from its first point.

max_rows.description: More rows than this is an error, never a truncated answer.

step.description: Lattice spacing inside `region`, at least the cell size.

SampleRow.description:
`height` is sampled bilinearly, every other layer at the nearest cell.
A value is null where the layer is nodata.

SceneryInRequest.description:
Either `region`, or `footprint_at` for exact overlap with a placed
footprint.

SceneryInResponse.description: More than 5 000 objects is an error, never a truncated answer.

SceneryObject.description: `obb_w` and `obb_d` are null for a model with no footprint.

ScoreSiteResponse.description: The site at its best orientation.

Sector.description: An arc of bearings, clockwise from `from_deg` to `to_deg`.

sector_summary.description: The same summaries over the requested `sector` only.

Term.description:
One criterion's contribution: the measured `value`, whether the hard test
passed, and the soft score from 0 to 1.

TpiClass.description:
A landform class from local relief, then regional relief, then slope:
the first that holds of `ridge`, `valley`, `upper`, `lower`, `mid`, and
`flat` otherwise.

TrafficabilityResponse.description:
Judged along the straight line to the nearest road, sampled every 25 m
for slope and water.

blocking.description: The first sample that fails, when one does.

reason.description: Why the line is or is not passable, for a reader.

first_seen.description: Where along the route the site first sees it; null when never.

resolution.description: Mask cell size; the file's cell size when omitted, and may be coarser.

ViewshedResponse.description:
The mask is `width` × `height` bits, row-major from the origin corner,
base64-encoded.

rings.description: The mask's outlines, when `as_polygons` was asked for.

blocking.description: The first terrain point in the way, with an absolute `alt`.

clearance_m.description:
The least vertical gap between sightline and terrain; negative when
blocked.
